summary: LightPath Technologies filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a combined primary and secondary offering of 7,142,800 shares of Class A common stock at $14.00 per share, with the primary offering of 3,571,400 shares sold by the company and the secondary by a selling stockholder. The offering price represents a ~17.5% discount to the last sale price of $16.98. Craig-Hallum acts as placement agent on a best-efforts basis. Delivery is expected on June 3, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
